creative_direction: Weave a crescent-shaped basket from fine warm rattan strips and place one white orchid within its curve. The basket stands upright, so its open woven ribs form an airy moon silhouette around the flower. Use a dark plum background and soft lateral light that reveals the alternating over-under pattern of the fibers. The orchid should have carefully modeled petals, a small pale yellow throat, and one short stem, remaining secondary to the unusual woven structure. Render frayed fiber ends sparingly at the inner edge, not throughout the object. Keep the entire basket visible with breathing room. No ribbons, tags, lettering, or surrounding arrangement of flowers.
